content.text: {"label":"outage","explanation":"P2 incident INC-20261024-1535 opened at 11:02: the net banking and mobile app login API is returning 503 errors after a certificate rotation. General volume rose from +47% at 10:45 to +91% at 11:00, and service level fell to 12.8%. login_issue calls are 2.71x normal. balance_enquiry and account_update are each about 1.4x, consistent with customers being locked out of self-service. Payments volume is at forecast (-2.5% today), there is no marketing campaign, and absences are normal (2 vs 1.8 usual), so this is a demand surge caused by the outage, not a staffing problem.","plan_name":"Login outage containment on general","rationale":"First cut avoidable outage calls: a known-issue IVR message for login_issue callers and chat deflection of balance enquiries. Then add capacity to general at once: delay breaks, cancel coaching and a small cross-skilled move from payments, kept small because payments slipped to 77.4% at 11:00 and must stay at or above 70%. Overtime is approved now to cover the period from 11:45 while the incident remains open. Callback limits abandonment during the worst peak. Expected overtime cost is about Rs 5,200 (roughly 7 accepted agents x 2 h x Rs 360), well within the Rs 15,000 budget.
